own: Unfortunately, this is probably the last remaining most underdeveloped part of the program, which is coming up with all the different settings that you can turn on with a click that give powers to the members of your team. We need to decide are we going to have different types of team members, or are they just going to be differentiated by which granular specific ability they have checked on and which one they have checked off for the others? So that needs to be figured out probably next. We need to come up with a list of all the abilities and features that we think the agents might want to grant their team members.
question: Should a team member with hold rights be able to cancel or approve the lead's waiting TEAM changes, such as removing or demoting a member?
